# kit-a

> A browser-based toolkit for system architecture diagrams and Gantt project planning. Drag, connect, plan, export — no sign-up, no bloat.

kit-a provides two tools: an architecture diagram editor with 14 node types, smart connections, and starter templates; and an interactive Gantt chart planner with 6 view modes, task dependencies, and multi-format export.

## Tools

- [Landing Page](https://kit-a.com/): Overview of kit-a toolkit features and capabilities
- [Arch Editor](https://kit-a.com/#/arch): Drag-and-drop architecture diagram editor with 14 component types
- [Gantt Planner](https://kit-a.com/#/gantt): Interactive Gantt chart for project planning and scheduling

## Features

- 14 node types: Client, Server, Database, API, Auth, Queue, Cache, Cloud, Bucket, Function, Monitor, Mobile, Web App, Group
- Smart connections: labeled, colored, directional or bidirectional with animated flow
- 6 architecture templates: 3-Tier Web App, Microservices, Event-Driven, Auth Flow, Auth0 Integration, CI/CD Pipeline
- 6 Gantt view modes: days, weeks, months, quarters, years, full timeline
- Export formats: PNG (2x), JPG, animated GIF, WebM video
- Save/load via localStorage and JSON import/export
